description: checks webhook timestamp age and future skew before signature verification using only bounded caller-supplied values. Call when you need a bounded webhook signature timestamp check result before accepting, caching, redirecting, or retrying a caller-supplied web response. Returns normalized web evidence, the computed finding, and an explicit pass or advisory status for Webhook Signature Timestamp Check as versioned deterministic JSON. Limitation: Evaluates only caller-supplied metadata; it performs no DNS lookup, HTTP request, web search, credential use, or persistent storage.

maximum_age_seconds.description: Maximum Age Seconds supplied to Webhook Signature Timestamp Check; used only for this bounded calculation and processed in memory without retention.

maximum_future_skew_seconds.description: Maximum Future Skew Seconds supplied to Webhook Signature Timestamp Check; used only for this bounded calculation and processed in memory without retention.

now_epoch.description: Now Epoch supplied to Webhook Signature Timestamp Check; used only for this bounded calculation and processed in memory without retention.

timestamp_epoch.description: Timestamp Epoch supplied to Webhook Signature Timestamp Check; used only for this bounded calculation and processed in memory without retention.

name: util_webhook_signature_timestamp_check
